name: VolunTeen Summer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in different parts of a hospital for a week. See the jobs that keep it running. A senior track lets older students log hours in June and July.
duration: Two one-week sessions (8 a.m. to 4 p.m., all five days), or a senior track of at least 40 hours in June and July
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Friday, April 10, with interviews in mid-April and answers by May 15. Dates for 2027 are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application packet by the deadline. Chosen applicants get an email and an interview. Call Volunteer Services at 931-502-1055 with questions.
notes: Clarksville is northwest of Nashville. The source is a hospital news post from March 2026. Confirm the 2027 dates with Volunteer Services. The Nashville Vanderbilt University Hospital page says volunteers must be 18 or older. It says its summer high school program is on hold.
